question: At the fixed qualified actual-108 sampled state, does R24's exhaustive all-cardinality antipodal-pair relation law transfer across every nonconstant complement-normalized binary partition?
hypothesis: Across all 32767 nonconstant complement-normalized binary partitions at actual-108, every one of the 32640 partitions that separates at least one antipodal pair will reproduce actual-108 full-five-coordinate membership in all four phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate panels, while all 127 nonconstant partitions preserving every antipodal pair will match zero panels; no partition will be partial, and the law will hold in every populated mask-cardinality stratum 1 through 15.

prior_evidence.observation: On the exhaustive sixteen-context state, all 32640 pair-splitting nonconstant complement-normalized partitions matched all four panels, all 127 pair-preserving partitions matched zero panels, every cardinality stratum 1 through 15 had zero law mismatches, and no partition was partial.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R24 dimension: the exhaustive sixteen-context state is replaced by the frozen actual-108 sampled state established in R10 and used in R21. Partition enumeration, complement normalization, antipodal-pair relation, four projections, exact membership comparison, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.r24_replication_control: Run the unchanged local deterministic R24 probe and require its frozen exact law and cardinalities before R25 output.
arms_and_inputs.actual108_state: Use the frozen deterministic R7 nested-prefix generator at exactly 108 records for each of 27 surfaces, yielding exactly 2916 records; require the R10 full-five-coordinate nine-class restoration control.
arms_and_inputs.partition_enumeration: Enumerate masks 1..65535 ascending; retain exactly masks with bit zero clear, yielding one representative of each nonconstant complement pair and exactly 32767 partitions.
arms_and_inputs.cardinality_strata: Stratify by mask popcount 1..15; require stratum k to contain exactly C(15,k) partitions and every stratum to be populated.
arms_and_inputs.pair_relation: For each q in 0..7 compare bit(q) with bit(q+8). A partition is pair_preserving only when all eight agree and pair_splitting otherwise.
arms_and_inputs.combinatorial_cardinalities: Require exactly 127 pair-preserving and 32640 pair-splitting partitions. Independently enumerate every nonempty subset of antipodal pairs 1..7, construct pair-union masks, and require its distinct set to equal the 127 pair-preserving masks.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For every retained mask evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], and [bucket,suffix1] against actual-108 full-five-coordinate membership, exactly 131068 arms in mask then coordinate order.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, pair-relation and cardinality-stratum cardinalities, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

The actual-108 full-five-coordinate control must reproduce 2916 records, exactly 108 records per surface, nine correct triplets, zero splits, and zero cross-entity collisions.
